quantity: sigma(pT)/pT in percent for single isolated muons: half-width of the 68 % interval of pT residuals centred on the mode, versus |eta|
source: CMS Collaboration, JINST 9 (2014) P10009, arXiv:1405.6569, Figure 14 (bottom panel), solid symbols, 'CMS simulation'. Tracks are not vertex- or beam-spot-constrained.
method: page rendered at 300 dpi with PyMuPDF; log axis calibrated on the 1 % and 10 % major ticks (298 px per decade); solid markers located by colour in a 7-pixel column at each 0.1 eta-bin centre, the +eta and -eta values averaged where both were found. Bins where markers overlapped are missing. Reading uncertainty about +-5 %.
